title: Sheng-Yun Brian Yu CV
subtitle: Tech Lead · 8 years in backend and platform engineering; led an 11-person cross-functional team; iterating faster with AI-assisted development

description.intro:
Hello, I am Sheng-Yun Yu (Brian Yu), a tech lead with around 8 years of experience. Node.js / TypeScript and NestJS on the backend, React / Next.js on the frontend, able to take a product line from schema design and APIs through the interface to deployment on my own.

At a gaming and live-streaming platform I moved from backend engineer to engineering manager, owning the microservice architecture, high-concurrency traffic, and the team's development standards.

Over the past year, AI-assisted development has been my primary way of working. At Feeling Bank, as a sole engineer working with AI agents, I delivered two product lines in six months (Bound built from scratch, Sugarbee taken over and maintained), shipped six Claude features, and launched on iOS and Android within six weeks. At Pacificsmart, I led the real-time AI interpretation platform Abestar Live from POC to production and introduced AI agents into the team's task dispatch, code review, and deployment workflows.

My method is to define completion criteria as automatically verifiable checks before handing implementation to agents, which accelerates delivery while maintaining a quality floor. When AI features go to production, I plan guardrails, fallback mechanisms, offline evaluation, and cost accounting alongside them.

I am seeking a tech lead or engineering manager role.
